name: Fan Out Research Subtopics (DISABLED — see ADR-028)
description: DISABLED. Fan-out requires deciding whether the researcher's output contains decomposable subtopics — a judgment call rules can't make deterministically from metadata. In the rule-skeleton + coordinator architecture (ADR-028), this decision belongs to the research coordinator agent. Re-enable when the coordinator lands; at that point the coordinator's terminal decide() tool will emit a triple like coordinator.next_action=fan_out and this rule can trigger off that structured signal.
